subject: S02 access-model decisions for later segments (media approval, question columns, flashcards, Aegra RLS)
body:
# S02 access-model decisions that later segments must know (landed in 5692e13)

1. **media_assets** are client-readable only when `review_status = 'approved'` (unreviewed YouTube candidates and
   AI figures stay hidden). **Seed (S05) must upsert its own figures with `review_status = 'approved'`.**
   `section_media` rows are visible only when both the section and the media asset are visible.
2. **questions**: clients have column-level `select` on `id, chapter_id, exam, block, stem_html, options,
   difficulty, taxonomy_ids, tags, source_id, status, created_at` only. Hidden from anon/authenticated:
   `answer, answer_html, explanation_html, why_not_html, educational_objective, review, stats`
   (objective and option stats reveal the answer). `select *` from a client role fails; S08 serves the
   rest through the API (service role) after an attempt.
3. **chapters**: `(owner_user_id is null and status = 'published') or owner_user_id = auth.uid()`; a CHECK
   ties `kind in ('user_upload','user_kb')` to `owner_user_id is not null` (private ⇔ owned).
   `chapter_sections` and `questions` inherit visibility from their chapter.
4. **flashcards**: shared cards (owner null) readable by all; a student may insert/update/delete their own
   private cards (`owner_user_id = auth.uid()`, `origin <> 'seed'`), so S14 does not need the service role.
5. **Backend-only columns** on user tables: `generated_media.approved_for_publish/ai_generated` (client may
   insert the rest and update `title`), `report_issues.status` (client may insert and update `body`).
6. **Composite FKs** keep parents per-user: `attempts(block_id,user_id)→blocks`, `notes(notebook_id,user_id)
   →notebooks`, `kb_sources(upload_id,user_id)→uploads`, `ingest_items(upload_id|kb_source_id,user_id)`.
7. `profiles.pathway_stage` references `pathway_stages(key)` on delete set null (null until S05 seeds).
8. `embeddings` has `unique nulls not distinct (owner_user_id, ref_type, ref_id, chunk_index)` for idempotent
   upserts (S07).
9. `naadi_alembic_version` has RLS forced and no client grants. **S04: Aegra's `alembic_version` and its
   tables land in `public`; `tests/db/test_rls_coverage.py` (every public table has RLS) and
   `tests/db/test_schema_doc.py` (db/schema.sql == public tables) will flag them** — enable RLS + revoke
   client grants on them in the same change, and exclude them from the schema-doc comparison.
10. Test infra: `apps/api/tests/db/stack.sh` runs `supabase/storage-api:v1.95.0` (the same 81 storage
    migrations as the real project) because the Postgres image ships an empty `storage` schema; CI db and e2e
    jobs run `stack.sh storage` against the service container.
11. Pre-existing on claude/naadi-shared (not S02): `biome check .` fails on markdown formatting of docs/*.md
    (MODEL_TESTS, PLAN, segments/*), so `pnpm lint` is red in CI's checks job until someone runs
    `biome format --write docs`.
